The '''Thand sector''' was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Montitian Grant sector/Legends|Montitian Grant sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], the [[Extorin sector/Legends|Extorin]] and [[Great Agash sector/Legends|Great Agash sectors]] [[spinward]], and the [[Trailing Grant sector/Legends|Trailing Grant sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. Together with the Great Agash and Trailing Grant [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], the Thand sector formed the Expansion Region's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Expansion" />

The Thand sector contained the [[Thandruss system/Legends|Thandruss system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which in turn was the site of the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Thandruss|same name]]. Thandruss was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Krytollak]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GG12" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thand sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the StarWars.com [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region] provided a visual depiction of the sector and placed it in grid squares J-14 and J-15.<ref name="Expansion" />
